_comment: Golden-set expansion 3 -> ~21 (docs/REASONING_LAYER_UPGRADE_PLAN.md §7, §11 item 4).
SYNTHETIC charts only (CLAUDE.md rule: never real birth data, names, or coordinates).
Annotated 2026-07-13 (P0-2 specialist sign-off, plan §15.3 item 3) by the chief
Thirukanitham specialist role per docs/PREDICTION_DOCTRINE_AND_ROADMAP.md's P0-2 task.
K21 added beyond the original 20-row plan to cover the new PARTIALLY_PROMISED reading
(app/reasoning/contradiction.py, §15.2 Option B decision, 2026-07-13) which did not
exist when this worksheet was scaffolded.
Mechanical-vs-flavour split: `gate_inputs` and `timing_score` are what the wired test
(tests/reasoning/test_life_areas_golden.py) actually feeds into assess_promise()/
classify() — every expected.gate/band/reading below is mechanically reproducible from
those two fields alone via promise_gate.py's exact dignity vocabulary and
timing_vote.py's exact score cutoffs (>=75 STRONG / >=60 LIKELY / >=45 MIXED / else
WEAK). `planets_rasi`/`varga_rasi_by_planet`/`transits`/`afflictions` are the fuller
synthetic-chart narrative context an astrologer reviews for plausibility (per the
annotation's reasoning) — they are not re-derived by code today, since no module
computes D1/varga dignity from raw rasi placements generically across all ten life
areas the way marriage_service.py does for RELATIONSHIPS alone.
Coverage target: every Reading value (PROMISED_AND_TIMED, PROMISED_NOT_NOW,
ACTIVE_BUT_UNPROMISED, PARTIALLY_PROMISED, NOT_PROMISED, MIXED, SILENT) appears at
least twice, and every life area in app/services/life_areas_service.py::_AREA_ROUTING
appears at least once. 'varga' below names the area's varga per _AREA_ROUTING (e.g.
RELATIONSHIPS -> D9, CAREER -> D10).

schema.name: short_snake_case_id
schema.target_area: one of _AREA_ROUTING's keys -- the life area this chart is annotated for
schema.target_reading: the Reading value this chart is meant to exercise (coverage bookkeeping)
schema.annotation: specialist's prose: which lord/karaka placements drive the gate grade, and why

input.planets_rasi: dict PLANET -> rasi 1-12, all nine grahas placed in D1 (narrative flavour)
input.varga: the varga code this row exercises, e.g. 'D9', 'D10'
input.varga_rasi_by_planet: dict PLANET -> rasi 1-12 in that varga (narrative flavour)
input.active_dasha_lords: list of maha/antar lords currently running (narrative flavour)
input.age: int, synthetic native's age as of as_of_date
input.afflictions: dict of area-relevant affliction flags (narrative flavour)
input.gate_inputs: MECHANICAL — the exact assess_promise() kwargs: bhava_lord_house, bhava_lord_afflicted, karaka_dignity_d1, karaka_dignity_varga, karaka_available
input.timing_score: MECHANICAL — int 0-100 fed to timing_band_from_score()/combine_gate_and_timing() as the pre-cap timing vote

expected.band: STRONG | LIKELY | MIXED | WEAK | BLOCKED | SILENT
expected.reading: PROMISED_AND_TIMED | PROMISED_NOT_NOW | ACTIVE_BUT_UNPROMISED | PARTIALLY_PROMISED | NOT_PROMISED | MIXED | SILENT
expected.window_note: free text, e.g. 'opens ~2029 when Venus dasha begins' (optional)

cases.name: K4_relationships_active_but_unpromised

Mechanically this alone forces gate=SILENT regardless of house/dignity flavour below. A strong current Venus mahadasha (timing_score=82, STRONG) is running, so the chart speaks 'active period, but the energy points elsewhere' rather than claiming a marriage window it has no promise signal for.

expected.window_note: no window claimed -- the chart has no marriage promise signal to time, even though the current period is generally active

expected.window_note: active now, under the current Sun mahadasha

expected.window_note: no window claimed at any dasha -- redirect to areas the chart supports

But karaka Mars is enemy-placed in both D1 and D4 -- karaka_ok fails. Exactly one condition holds -> WEAK (a genuine partial promise, distinct from K11/K18's SILENT rows where the karaka signal is missing entirely). The current period is strongly active (timing_score=78, STRONG, pre-cap) -- the chart offers real but incomplete support, so this reads as 'partially promised', not the full redirect a SILENT+active chart would get, and the published band is capped down to LIKELY per the WEAK-gate rule.
